part: MIDI 1.0 Electrical Specification Update [2014] (CA-033) - the MIDI OUT circuit for issue #37's TRS MIDI out (5 V and 3.3 V rows)
notes: 6 pp, issue date Aug 1 2014, MMA approval Jan 20 2014, primary author Tom Savell. Text layer extracts in full (pymupdf). Read for #37: p.2 31.25 kbaud +/-1 %, 8-N-1, 320 us per byte; 5 mA current loop, logical 0 = current ON, rise/fall under 2 us. Figure 1 p.3 MIDI OUT: pin 4 to VTX through RA, UART (optional buffer) to pin 5 through RC, pin 2 to ground at the transmitter only; table: VTX +5 V +/-10 % -> RA 220 ohm 5 % 0.25 W, RC 220 ohm 5 % 0.25 W; VTX +3.3 V +/-5 % -> RA 33 ohm 5 % 0.5 W, RC 10 ohm 5 % 0.25 W. Optional ferrite beads 1k at 100 MHz (MMZ1608Y102BT or similar), as close to the jack as possible (p.6). Jack shield of a MIDI OUT may be N/C or grounded (p.3). p.5: the 3.3 V row assumes an open-collector/open-drain buffer driving RC; RA short to ground 0.111 A, 0.383 W at +5 % supply. A second copy at https://mitxela.com/other/ca33.pdf (same 6 pp, different bytes, sha256 c798234e23e21c1eee663e3d1dfb6daec0ee58d0459b748a21764a32ba072371) was fetched the same day and not banked.

part: Specification for use of TRS Connectors with MIDI Devices [RP-054] - pin-out for issue #37's TRS MIDI out jack
notes: THIRD-PARTY MIRROR of the MMA document: midi.org's own page (https://midi.org/specification-for-use-of-trs-connectors-with-midi-devices, HTTP 200) offers the download only after a member login, and https://www.midi.org/component/edocman/rp-054-specification-for-use-of-trs-connectors-with-midi-devices/download returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-04. The banked file is 2 pp, (C) 2017-18 MMA/AMEI, version 0.941, last revised 05/17/2018, MMA approval 06/08/2018, AMEI 07/18/2018; text and drawing agree with the published standard as widely reproduced, but it is not from the publisher's host. Read for #37: p.1 drawing - TIP = DIN pin 5, RING = DIN pin 4, SLEEVE = DIN pin 2 (the 'Type A' wiring); circuitry per CA-033; 'manufacturers are strongly advised to add protection circuitry (e.g. to handle the case when a DC-coupled headphone driver is connected to a MIDI output)'. p.2: 2.5 mm recommended, other sizes allowed with the rest of the spec unchanged; adapter cables shielded twisted pair, 2 m max; audio TRS cables between two TRS devices not acceptable.

part: SJ5-43502PM (3.5 mm 4-conductor panel-mount jack, vertical, M7 x 0.75 threaded shell with nut, solder tabs) - candidate J-MIDI-OUT for issue #37 options (a) and (c)
notes: 3 pp, dated 09/12/2024. Text layer carries the drawing callouts. Read for #37: p.1 16 Vdc, 300 mA max (20 mA min), 50 mohm contact, 5,000 cycles. p.2 drawing: M7X0.75 thread 4.5 long, a 2.00 nut, a 1.5 collar, body d9.0 x 10.2 behind it, solder tabs 4.0 beyond; hex 10.0 as drawn; pins 1 tip, 2 ring 1, 3 ring 2, 4 sleeve (a TRS plug's sleeve spans ring 2 and sleeve, so both are wired to MIDI pin 2). The thickest panel it can clamp is not printed; 4.5 - 2.0 = 2.5 mm is a calc from the drawing, to confirm with the part in hand. Fetched from the product page https://www.sameskydevices.com/product/interconnect/connectors/audio-connectors/jacks/sj5-43502pm (HTTP 200).

part: SN74LVC1G07 single buffer, open-drain output (candidate U-MIDI-BUF, the CA-033 Figure 1 buffer driving RC for issue #37's MIDI out)
notes: SCES296AG, February 2000, revised October 2025. Read for #37: 'Input and open-drain output accept voltages up to 5.5V' (p.1 features); recommended operating conditions VO 0-5.5 V, IOL 16 mA at VCC 3 V and 24 mA (the two columns of the 3 V row), 32 mA at 4.5 V; VIH 2 V and VIL 0.8 V at VCC 3-3.6 V. Lets a 3V3 GPIO sink the 5 V MIDI loop of CA-033's first row. Banked as the ALTERNATIVE: the study's recommended circuit uses U-LVLSHIFT's spare 74AHCT125 gates B and C (push-pull, 5 V) because Type A/B must be swappable in firmware, which an open-drain sink on one line cannot do.
